text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- A Chinese friendship delegation, headed by Party Central Committee member Qi Huai Yuan, is visiting Vietnam.
-- Authorities in the northern coastal province of Nghe An haev submitted plans for the expansion of Cua Lo port into a major regional terminal.
-- Government ministries are concerned about the low quality and technical standard as well as high costs of equipment being imported by joint-venture and foreign invested enterprises.
-- An Asian Development bank expert has said Vietnam's economy is facing major challenges with poverty elimination, rural migration and managing investment.
-- National Assembly chairman Nong Duc Manh had held talks with the regional director of the United Nations Children's Fund on child care and protection.
-- Gross Domestic Product in Hanoi is expected to increase by 12.3 percent in 1996.
-- Vietnam will have 1.96 million telephones by the end of 1996.
-- Foreign Minister Nguyen Manh Cam is travelling to Paris to attend the second meeting of the France-Vietnam Joint Commission before heading for Morocco for talks on next year's Francophonie summit.
